message: the triangle keeps direct dimensions and Undo before optional trade proportion and memory tools

copy.triangle-rectangle-area: Bounding rectangle: 14400 square units · triangle: 7200 square units.
copy.triangle-rectangle-help: The triangle fills half its width-by-height rectangle. The other half is not extra triangle area.
copy.triangle-equation: Area = base × height ÷ 2. When area stays at 7,200, widening the base lowers the top.
copy.triangle-height-help: Unlock the area to move the height on its own. Locking again brings the area back to 7,200.
copy.triangle-ruler-help: The bottom ruler is width. The dashed line is height, measured straight down to the base.
copy.triangle-comparison: Keep a triangle to compare dimensions.
copy.triangle-comparison-help: Ratios compare this shape with the kept outline. Doubling the width need not double the area.
copy.triangle-match-help: Keep this width and adjust only the unlocked height to match the kept area. A match outside the height range is unavailable.
copy.triangle-match-width-help: Keep this height and change only the unlocked width to match the kept area. The required width must fit the range and the ten-unit steps.
copy.triangle-trade-help: Each move trades width for height without changing this triangle’s area. At the range limits, a move may not fit.
copy.triangle-proportion-help: Keep the width and change the unlocked height. Unlike the width-height trade, this changes area.
